edges.reason: transfer routes msg.sender as the sender of the transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance subtraction.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_transfer receives msg.sender as the from address.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to fee wallet 1.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to fee wallet 1.
cooldown state is written from block.timestamp allowing miner influence.
_transfer gates transfers on cooldown values derived from block.timestamp.
swap deadline is set to block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
from parameter flows into reflection accounting.
to parameter flows into reflection accounting.
amount parameter drives fee computation and max tx checks.
recipient parameter is used as the transfer destination.
bots_ array entries are written into the bots blacklist.
notbot address is cleared from the bots mapping.
tokenAmount is the amount approved and swapped by the router.
sender parameter is debited in _transferStandard.
tAmount drives the reflection value computation.
onoff toggles the cooldownEnabled state variable.
contractTokenBalance is read inside _transfer to size the swap.
contractETHBalance is forwarded into sendETHToFee.
path array is passed to the router swap call.
currentRate converts the team fee into reflections.
tTeam is the team fee amount credited to the contract.
_transfer calls the external swap before finishing its own accounting.
_transfer performs native ETH transfers to external wallets mid-transfer.
_transfer always delegates accounting to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard credits the team fee after debiting the sender.
_transferStandard reflects the fee afterwards.
_takeTeam writes the contract reflection balance.
_reflectFee reduces the total reflections state variable.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call that can re-enter via token hooks.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to external wallets which may execute fallback code.
openTrading sends ETH to the router/pair via addLiquidityETH.
manualswap invokes the swap routine directly, bypassing transfer locking.
manualswap triggers an external swap while holding contract balances.
manualsend forwards the whole contract balance to fee transfers.
openTrading assigns the router instance used for swaps.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
renounceOwnership authorization depends on the caller identity.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only feeds the internal _transferStandard accounting and has no standalone security role.
The to parameter only feeds the internal _transferStandard accounting and has no standalone security role.
The amount parameter is consumed by the core _transfer fee and limit logic.
The recipient parameter is simply forwarded to the core transfer entrypoint.
The bots_ array is only iterated by the setBots administrative function.
The notbot argument is only used inside delBot.
The tokenAmount parameter is only used by swapTokensForEth.
The sender parameter is a renamed from value consumed by _transferStandard.
The tAmount parameter is the transfer amount consumed by _transferStandard.
The onoff flag is only written by setCooldownEnabled.
This local is computed inside _transfer to size the automatic swap.
This local holds the ETH amount forwarded to sendETHToFee.
The swap path local is built and used only inside swapTokensForEth.
The currentRate local is consumed by _takeTeam reflection conversion.
The tTeam local is the fee amount credited by _takeTeam.
